translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Rom
book.title: Rom Nalob̃ulat napisulan aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Rom

content: B̃imagenan, ivoi mabe hǝn avan ideh b̃evi Ju? Ivoi mabe hǝn b̃ikad na-tiv-dalusi-an?
Ivoi habat len natit p̃isi! Metǝkav ikad natsua: aGot eriŋ nasoruan san len navǝlan naJu gail.
Be galit galevis asike lǝb̃idaŋ len aGot, gunau ke nǝ-par-dǝlomi-an salito igol aGot sǝdaŋ len na-kel-gati-an san gail a?
Ao! Satimaienan! AGot ekitin, akis igol nǝsa tokele, naut kǝmas nǝvanuan p̃isi lovi vanuan nalibliboŋan gail. Hum aTevit aKiŋ tokele sutuai ke,

content.text: “Nasub̃ aGot, natit p̃isi gotokele m̃au, ekitin.
Avan ideh b̃ike b̃isor tas gaiug len nakotan,
dereh tisab̃ sǝhoti ke gotonor, gokitin,
ale dereh gewin len nakotan enan.”

content: Be nǝsaan sidat b̃eṽusan p̃arp̃ar hǝn nanoran siGot, datekǝmabe? Datolǝboi datb̃ike aGot sanor nǝboŋ topansem gidato a? Ao! Ikad nǝvanuan lotonau tomaienan,
be nǝnauan salit sakitin. AGot asike tanor, asike talǝboi tapǝpehun navoian dan nǝsaan hǝn navile a pan.

Ikad nǝvanuan lotoke, “Be nalibliboŋan sagw b̃igol p̃arp̃ar hǝn nakitinan siGot gol nǝvanuan gail lǝb̃isal suh nǝyalyalan san, b̃imaienan, imabe aGot ipansem ginau sal sil nalibliboŋan sagw hum tovi saan?”
Ale nǝvanuan galevis lusor mǝdas ginamito. Lukel ke, namtuke, “Namtigol nǝsaan hǝn nǝsaan b̃igol navoian!” Alat lotokǝmaienan, dereh lipanis, ale ivoi hǝn lǝb̃ipanis!
Sǝkad nǝvanuan nanoran ideh

Ale datekǝmabe? Mǝtunau ke ginamit namttovi Ju, len nǝhon aGot namtuvoi sǝhor nǝvanuan tile gail am a? Ao, namtsǝmaienan. Noil hirhir len nǝsa notokele tia ke, nǝvanuan p̃isi, naJu gail mai alat lǝsavi Ju, galit p̃isi lugolgol nǝsaan. Nǝsaan iwol hǝn nǝmauran salito.
Hum natosian siGot toke,

content.text: “Sǝkad nǝvanuan nanoran ideh,
sasua kasi.
Sǝkad avan ideh tokad nalǝboian kitin,
sǝkad avan ideh tolǝŋon ke telǝboi aGot
Galit p̃isi lupair dani,
naṽide salit p̃isi isa batbat.
Sǝkad avan ideh togol navoian,
sasua kasi.”
“Nasoruan salit isa hum nǝb̃on nab̃irimat tob̃os nǝtan.
Namealito igol nagǝgǝrasan.
Nǝsa lotokele igol nasǝnahan,
hum nabehi hǝn nǝm̃at togole nǝboŋ tohat nǝvanuan.”
“Nabuŋolit epul hǝn nasoruan namǝdasian mai na-mǝtahun-buni-an.”
“Lusaṽsaṽut hǝn lǝb̃igol nǝmatan.
Lugol namǝdasian mai na-lǝŋon-isa-an len naut p̃isi lotovi lan.
Lǝsalǝboi lǝb̃itoh mai nǝvanuan tile ideh len natǝm̃at.”
“Lǝsamǝtahw len nǝyalyalan siGot. Lǝsǝnau.”

content: Gidat datolǝboii ke natideh nalo tokele, ikele van hǝn alat lototoh len navǝlan nalo, hǝn nǝvanuan gail asike lǝb̃elǝboi lǝb̃etǝtas gol galit am, ale hǝn b̃imasil ke nǝvanuan p̃isi len navile a pan dereh likot len nakotan siGot.
Imaienan, avan ideh salǝboi b̃inor len nǝhon aGot husur togol husur nalo. Nalo ipat ŋai hǝn datb̃ebunus lǝboi nǝsaan sidato lan.
Datunor mabe len nǝhon aGot?
Be gagai, aGot evǝhot nap̃isal hǝn datb̃inor len nǝhon, ale na-gol-husur-nalo-an savi natideh hǝni. Nap̃isal enan, nalo siMoses mai ahai kelkel ur gail lopǝhav utaut hǝni sutuai tia.
AGot eriŋi ke dattonor len nǝhon nǝboŋ dattoriŋ nǝlodat len aYesu Kristo. Imaienan hǝn nǝvanuan p̃isi lotokad nadǝlomian. Nǝvanuan p̃isi lop̃itp̃itoṽ,
husur nǝvanuan p̃isi lugol nǝsaan, ŋa lutoh a tut, a tut masuṽ dan aGot, lǝsanor kasi hǝn lǝb̃ibar nǝyalyalan san.
Avil, len naviolan hǝn navoian aGot toviol kǝmas hǝni, len aKristo aYesu toṽur nǝmakuvan sidato, aGot eriŋi ke dattonor len nǝhon.

AGot eviol hǝn aYesu hum naviolan hǝn natutumavan, hǝn nǝmatan san b̃idakuv nǝlol paŋpaŋ siGot, nǝlon topǝŋas nǝvanuan gail sil nǝsaan salito. Len nadǝlomian lotokade len nǝmatan siYesu m̃os galito, aGot erub̃at nǝsaan salit dan galito. Natutumavan hǝn aYesu igol nanoran siGot ip̃arp̃ar, bathut ke, satutut hǝn tomǝtahun galito, ekǝta sǝhor nǝsaan silat ta m̃o, ta sutuai, sǝpansem galito.

AGot igol natgalenan hǝn nanoran san b̃imasil len nǝboŋ ta damǝŋai. Igol tomaienan hǝn gai gabag b̃inor, ale hǝn b̃igol nǝvanuan lǝb̃inor len nǝhon, lǝb̃ikad navoivoian maii nǝboŋ lotokad nadǝlomian len aYesu topanis salito.

Imagenan, datolǝboi datb̃isor patpat gidat mǝhat hǝn natideh a? Aoa! Datolǝboi datb̃ikad navoivoian mai aGot len nalo dattogol husuri a? Ao! Datukad navoivoian mai aGot husur datukad nadǝlomian len aYesu.
Nǝbathusoruan sagw imaiegai ke: len nadǝlomian dattokade, aGot eriŋi ke dattonor len nǝhon, savi len nalo dattogol husuri.
AGot evi Got seJu gail ŋa? Be alat lǝsavi Ju, gai savi aGot salito a? Evoi! Evi aGot salito am!
Husur Got esua ŋai. Len nadǝlomian eriŋi ke nǝvanuan gail lunor len nǝhon, naut kǝmas lotokad na-tiv-dalusi-an o lǝsǝkade.
Namilen ke nadǝlomian igol nalo evi ut kǝmas a? Ao Sǝmaienan! Nǝboŋ dattoriŋ nǝlodato len aGot, datugol husur nalo len nakitinan.

footnotes.text: 3.2 Len naut egai aPol ike metǝkav, be sakel natideh tovi na-vǝha-ru-an tohusuri.
3.8 Len naves 5-8, aPol isor var naJu gail nǝlolit topǝŋas aPol husur lotonau ke aPol tokel ke nalo tovi ut kǝmas.
3.21 Rom 1.17. Len naut egai nasoruan ta Kris sake siMoses, be nalo aPol tosor husuri evi nalob̃ulat torim aMoses totos gail.
